pageTitle: HoYoFair Spring 2023 Genshin Impact Fan Art Special Program Now Available! Participate in the livestream discussion to win merchandise rewards~
name: HoYoFair Spring 2023: Genshin Impact Fan Art Special Program Now Available! Participate in the livestream discussion to win merchandise rewards~
description: The Traveler and company have been invited to explore the ruins and enjoy the refreshing spring day. Yet something unexpected happens on their way. Let us unlock "Spring Wonderland" and watch the HoYoFair Spring 2023: Genshin Impact Fan Art Special Program! While watching the stream, feel free to share your thoughts on its content in the Comments section of this post. Participate in this discussion and you may win merchandise rewards~<hr />HoYoFair presents a collation of fan works derived from HoYoverse IPs. You can find a rich variety of fan art here as well as creators and players from all over the world who engage in multilingual creations and interactions. Here, everyone can express their love for games.
